title: 🐱 Playful & Sweet Cats Ready for Adoption in Kingman - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Kingman has some wonderful cats waiting for a cozy home to call their own. If you’ve been thinking about adding a feline friend to your family, take a look at these adoptable cuties.
Smokie Breed: Russian Blue Age: Adult Gender: Female Color: Gray/Blue Adoption Fee: $85 Shelter: Mohave County Animal Shelter Phone: (928) 753-2727 Smokie is a beautiful gray Russian Blue mix with that classic, plush coat and striking color. As an adult cat , she’s likely past the wild kitten stage and may be a calmer companion for someone wanting a more settled kitty.
👉 Meet Smokie and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Snow White Breed: Domestic Mediumhair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Female Color: Tan/Fawn Adoption Fee: $95 Shelter: Mohave County Animal Shelter Phone: (928) 753-2727 Snow White is a fluffy medium-haired kitten with a soft tan coat. She’s young, so she’ll need a family ready for kitten energy, playtime, and gentle guidance as she grows.
👉 Meet Snow White and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Gloria Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Female Color: Tan/Fawn Adoption Fee: $95 Shelter: Mohave County Animal Shelter Phone: (928) 753-2727 Gloria is a sweet shorthair kitten with a soft tan coat. She’s at the perfect age for bonding and learning the routine of her new home.
👉 Meet Gloria and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Coco Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Female Color: White Adoption Fee: $95 Shelter: Mohave County Animal Shelter Phone: (928) 753-2727 Coco is a lovely white kitten with a short coat. She’s looking for a family who can give her playtime, toys, and lots of gentle affection as she grows up.
👉 Meet Coco and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Count Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Male Color: Black (All) Adoption Fee: $100 Shelter: Feral Cat Warriors Inc Phone: (865) 217-6532 Count is a sleek all-black kitten with classic house panther looks. He’s young and ready to learn all about toys, treats, and comfy laps.
👉 Meet Count and apply to adopt on adoptapet
